summary: SERTEX Mobile FAZ B2 Wave 2 (Task Sharing / Görev Paylaşımı) — end-to-end verification on Expo web preview at mobile viewport 390x844. All 6 requested flows PASS: (1) PAYLAŞIM section renders in task detail directly BELOW EKLER (bounding-box Y: EKLER=352, PAYLAŞIM=462); (2) 'Paylaş' [testID task-detail-share-add] opens the share modal titled 'Kullanıcıyla Paylaş'; (3) search 'ahmet' [task-detail-share-search] returns 1 candidate, tapping [task-detail-share-user-<id>] switches to the permission picker, toggling [task-detail-share-perm-edit] + [task-detail-share-perm-complete] then [task-detail-share-save] persists via PUT /api/tasks/{id}/shares and closes the modal; (4) share item [task-detail-share-item-<uid>] appears with Turkish permission summary 'Görüntüle · Düzenle · Tamamla'; (5) tapping the item re-opens the edit modal with existing perms pre-filled, toggling assign+delete and re-saving updates the summary to 'Görüntüle · Düzenle · Tamamla · Ata · Sil'; (6) [task-detail-share-remove-<uid>] removes the row instantly and the section reverts to the empty state 'Bu görev kimseyle paylaşılmadı.'. Because the UI reflects only what api.setShares returns (onUpdated(updated); setRows(fromTask(updated))), backend persistence of shared_with is implicitly verified through the round-trip. No 401s, no crashes, no red screens. One minor cosmetic code issue: SharesSection uses colors.background (undefined in theme; the theme exports colors.bgBase) — non-blocking, ships as inherited/default color on web.

ui_bugs.issue: Uses colors.background which does not exist on the theme (theme exports colors.bgBase). On web preview text still renders (falls back to CSS inherited/default color) so 'Paylaş' save button label and active-chip labels look readable but slightly off contrast. On a native build the color may render as undefined/default black. Reference: /app/mobile/src/components/SharesSection.tsx:256,269,363,371 — replace colors.background with colors.bgBase.

issues: Permission chip active state relies on colors.background (undefined) for label text color; visually acceptable on web preview but should be fixed for native contrast (see ui_bug above).

react_native_issues.issue: App-wide non-blocking deprecation warning 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Not caused by SharesSection — carried over from prior iterations.

action_items: LOW: Fix colors.background → colors.bgBase in /app/mobile/src/components/SharesSection.tsx (lines 256, 269, 363, 371). This is the ONLY code issue found; feature is otherwise production-ready on mobile web preview.

Optional native smoke: run the same flow on Expo Go / dev-client to confirm the permission chip label & save button label render with the correct dark color on cyan (native RN would show default black on undefined color, may look OK; but bgBase (#02040A) is the intended contrast).

rca of the issue: No functional bug this iteration. Injection of <SharesSection task={task} onUpdated={setTask} onAuthError={handle401} /> at /app/mobile/app/task/[id].tsx:322 (directly below <AttachmentsSection />) is correct and renders as required. Sole cosmetic remark: colors.background is undefined in /app/mobile/src/theme/colors.ts (only bgBase/surface/surfaceAlt/primary exist), so SharesSection.tsx lines 256/269/363/371 pass color=undefined to the Ionicons icon and Text style — on react-native-web this results in inherited/default browser color and still looks OK, but on native it will render as the platform default (usually black) which is fine on cyan but not the intended #02040A. Fix is a one-line find-and-replace.
